p1.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2023/01/01.03.23.gflbrfarelease.pdf
p1.excerpt: Revenue from new gaming facilities is expected to generate substantial fiscal benefit to New York’s public schools, local governments, and problem gambling treatment services. The jobs created by these casinos must deliver livable wages to help families live, stay, and prosper in New York.

p2.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/gi1.rwnyc_.executivesummary.pdf
p2.excerpt: RWNYC maintains strong labor relationships and collective bargaining agreements to ensure fair wages and job security.

p3.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/07/gi1.rwnyc_.executivesummary.pdf
p3.excerpt: The current median wage at RWNYC is $39 per hour, annualized at more than $80,000. When benefits are factored in, our median compensation package totals nearly $150,000 a year.

decisions.label: ENTAILMENT
decisions.reason: Passage p1 states verbatim that "The jobs created by these casinos must deliver livable wages," which matches the claim about the New York gaming RFA.

decisions.label: NEUTRAL
decisions.reason: p1 contains the livable-wages requirement but gives no numerical wage floor, and no other excerpt addresses whether the RFA specifies one.

decisions.label: NEUTRAL
decisions.reason: p6 only mentions "Labor Peace Agreements" in a materials title and does not establish that the RFA identifies such an agreement as an ongoing material license condition.

decisions.reason: p3 says RWNYC's current median wage is more than $80,000 and median compensation is nearly $150,000, but it is not a Board report projection of a roughly $150,000 median wage.
